design.name: 沙暴巨像
design.brief: The desert chapter boss: a colossal ancient sandstone temple guardian awakened by the bandits' stolen fire. A massive blocky carved sandstone body with very broad shoulders and long heavy arms, huge stone fists each with a clearly separate thumb and four thick stone fingers, a serene carved god-face head with a tall gold crown and glowing ember-orange eyes, a cracked chest with a glowing ember-orange fire core caged in a gold ring, worn sun-and-spiral carvings, gold bands on the arms. The bandits have hung crimson war banners with the gold spiral emblem and heavy iron chains on its shoulders and waist, and a torn sand-coloured loincloth. Thick stone legs and broad stone feet with five blocky toes. Sand pours from its cracks.
design.weapon: no weapon; one fist raised for a ground slam
